name: testyourtaste
description: Turn research keywords into a real-paper guessing game, with built-in usage help.

interface.shortDescription: Guess the journal and citations of a real paper.
interface.longDescription: Accept comma-separated research keywords, retrieve a matching Chinese- or English-language paper from the public Test Your Taste game, and present its year, title, abstract, six journal choices, and five citation-range choices without revealing the answers. Use @testyourtaste help for instructions.
defaultPrompt: @testyourtaste "湖泊生态, 水生植物, 恢复"
